paragraphs: Yosef of Huzal. See the entry Issi ben Yehudah,[^1]

notes.text: איש הוצל means “man of Huzal,” rendered “of Huzal.” The complete target name Issi ben Yehudah is present despite the terminal comma. The heading was recorded as provisional, and the notice alone does not establish the original entry’s full extent or identify the place.
